title: Bram and the Bell
author: Vesper Joubert
blurb: Marguerite Coldharbour, a pest controller called to something with fingerprints, keeps the lights on and the doors counted. Then the sleep recordings capture a second voice answering questions — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must finish the ritual the founders started, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
